```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '..')
```

```{r}
require(dplyr)
require(ggplot2)
require(recipes)
require(caret)
require(glmnet)
require(rio)

dir.create('output', showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create('figures', showWarnings = FALSE)

cog <- import('data/nhanes_cognition.csv', header = TRUE)

dim(cog)
```

## 1. Indicating variable types so I can group them later

```{r}
outcome <- c('delayed_recall')

id <- c('id')

categorical <- c('trouble_sleeping','sleep_disorder','gender','race',
                 'diabetes','high_bp','smoker_ever','alcohol_12plus',
                 'vigorous_activity','moderate_activity','cycle')

numeric <- c('sleep_hours','age','education','poverty_ratio','depression','bmi')

for(i in categorical){
  cog[,i] <- as.factor(cog[,i])
}
```

## 2. Handling missing data and calculating descriptives

```{r}
missing_data <- data.frame(missing_datapercent = round(colMeans(is.na(cog))*100, 1))
missing_data

export(missing_data, 'output/missingness.csv')
```

```{r}
# numeric
desc_numeric <- data.frame(
  mean = sapply(cog[, c(outcome, numeric)], mean, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd   = sapply(cog[, c(outcome, numeric)], sd, na.rm = TRUE),
  min  = sapply(cog[, c(outcome, numeric)], min, na.rm = TRUE),
  max  = sapply(cog[, c(outcome, numeric)], max, na.rm = TRUE))
round(desc_numeric, 2)

export(round(desc_numeric, 2), 'output/descriptives_numeric.csv')

# categorical
desc_categorical <- do.call(rbind, lapply(categorical, function(v){
  tab <- table(cog[, v], useNA = 'ifany')
  data.frame(variable = v, level = names(tab), n = as.numeric(tab),
             percent = round(100*as.numeric(tab)/nrow(cog), 1))
}))
desc_categorical

export(desc_categorical, 'output/descriptives_categorical.csv', row.names = FALSE)
```

## 3. Making the blueprint

```{r}
blueprint <- recipe(x = cog,
                    vars = c(id, outcome, categorical, numeric),
                    roles = c('id', 'outcome', rep('predictor', 17))) |>
  step_indicate_na(all_of(categorical), all_of(numeric)) |>
  step_zv(all_numeric()) |>
  step_impute_mean(all_of(numeric)) |>
  step_impute_mode(all_of(categorical)) |>
  step_poly(all_of(numeric), degree = 2) |> # relationship btwn sleep and cog perf is usually an inverted-U so this gives us that shape
  step_normalize(paste0(numeric,'_poly_1'), paste0(numeric,'_poly_2')) |> # standardizes each of the polynomial columns
  step_dummy(all_of(categorical), one_hot = TRUE) # gives each category its own indicator variable, still not entirely sure how/why this works but it does!

blueprint
```

## 4. Making the train/test split

```{r}
set.seed(03022000)

loc <- sample(1:nrow(cog), round(nrow(cog) * 0.8))
cog_train <- cog[loc, ]
cog_test <- cog[-loc, ]

dim(cog_train)
dim(cog_test)
```

## 5. Setting up the CV

```{r}
cog_train <- cog_train[sample(nrow(cog_train)),]

folds <- cut(seq(1, nrow(cog_train)), breaks = 10, labels = FALSE)

my_indices <- vector('list', 10)
for(i in 1:10){
  my_indices[[i]] <- which(folds != i)
}

cv <- trainControl(method = "cv", index = my_indices)

eval_reg <- function(pred, obs){
  c(Rsquare = cor(obs, pred)^2,
    MAE = mean(abs(obs - pred)),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2)))
}
```

## 6. Basic linear regression

```{r}
caret_lm <- caret::train(blueprint, data = cog_train, method = "lm", trControl = cv)

caret_lm$results
```

## 7. Linear regression w/ ridge penalty

```{r}
grid <- data.frame(alpha = 0, lambda = 10^seq(-3, 1, length.out = 100)) # 0.001 to 10 bc who knows what we will need

ridge <- caret::train(blueprint,
                      data = cog_train,
                      method = "glmnet",
                      trControl = cv,
                      tuneGrid = grid)

ridge$bestTune
```

## 8. Linear regression w/ lasso penalty

```{r}
grid <- data.frame(alpha = 1, lambda = 10^seq(-4, 0, length.out = 100)) # 0.0001 to 1 bc assignment 2 showed a lower lambda was better for lasso reg

lasso <- caret::train(blueprint,
                      data = cog_train,
                      method = "glmnet",
                      trControl = cv,
                      tuneGrid = grid)

lasso$bestTune
```

## 9. Calculating test performance for each model

```{r}
perf <- data.frame(Model = c('Linear Regression', 'Ridge Regression', 'Lasso Regression'),
                   rbind(eval_reg(predict(caret_lm, cog_test), cog_test$delayed_recall),
                         eval_reg(predict(ridge, cog_test), cog_test$delayed_recall),
                         eval_reg(predict(lasso, cog_test), cog_test$delayed_recall)))

perf$lambda <- c(NA, ridge$bestTune$lambda, lasso$bestTune$lambda)

perf[, -1] <- round(perf[, -1], 4)
knitr::kable(perf)

export(perf, 'output/model_performance.csv', row.names = FALSE)
```

Baseline: predicting the training mean for everyone.

```{r}
base_pred <- mean(cog_train$delayed_recall)
baseline  <- c(MAE = mean(abs(cog_test$delayed_recall - base_pred)),
               RMSE = sqrt(mean((cog_test$delayed_recall - base_pred)^2)))
round(baseline, 3)

final_name <- perf$Model[which.min(perf$RMSE)]
final_mod  <- switch(final_name,
                     'Linear Regression' = caret_lm,
                     'Ridge Regression' = ridge,
                     'Lasso Regression' = lasso)
final_name
```

## 10. Most important predictors

```{r}
if(final_name == 'Linear Regression'){
  coefs <- as.matrix(coef(final_mod$finalModel))
} else {
  coefs <- as.matrix(coef(final_mod$finalModel, final_mod$bestTune$lambda))
}

coefs <- coefs[rownames(coefs) != '(Intercept)', , drop = FALSE] # the empty set of commas means to select all cols
coefs[is.na(coefs)] <- 0

ind <- order(abs(coefs[,1]), decreasing = TRUE)

top10 <- data.frame(predictor = rownames(coefs)[ind[1:10]],
                    coefficient = round(coefs[ind[1:10], 1], 3),
                    row.names = NULL)
top10

export(top10, 'output/top10_predictors.csv', row.names = FALSE)

if(final_name == 'Lasso Regression'){
  cat('Predictors kept by lasso:', sum(coefs[,1] != 0), 'of', nrow(coefs), '\n')
}
```

## 11. Figures

```{r}
p1 <- cog |>
  filter(!is.na(sleep_hours)) |>
  mutate(sleep_cat = cut(sleep_hours, breaks = c(0, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12),
                         labels = c('<=5', '6', '7', '8', '9', '10+'))) |>
  group_by(sleep_cat) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(delayed_recall), se = sd(delayed_recall)/sqrt(n()), n = n()) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = sleep_cat, y = mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - 1.96 * se, ymax = mean + 1.96 * se), width = .2) +
  xlab('Self-reported sleep (hours per night)') +
  ylab('Mean delayed recall (0-10)') +
  theme_bw()

p1
ggsave('figures/fig1_recall_by_sleep.png', p1, width = 6, height = 4)
```

```{r}
p2 <- ggplot(lasso$results, aes(x = lambda, y = RMSE)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = lasso$bestTune$lambda, lty = 2) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  xlab(expression(lambda ~ '(log scale)')) +
  ylab('Cross-validated RMSE') +
  theme_bw()

p2
ggsave('figures/fig2_lasso_tuning.png', p2, width = 6, height = 4)
```

```{r}
p3 <- ggplot(data.frame(pred = predict(final_mod, cog_test), obs = cog_test$delayed_recall), aes(x = pred, y = obs)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = .3, height = .2, width = 0) +
  geom_abline(lty = 2) +
  xlab('Predicted delayed recall') +
  ylab('Observed delayed recall') +
  theme_bw()

p3
ggsave('figures/fig3_predicted_vs_observed.png', p3, width = 5, height = 5)
```

```{r}
p4 <- ggplot(top10, aes(x = reorder(predictor, abs(coefficient)), y = coefficient)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  xlab('') +
  ylab('Coefficient (change in words recalled)') +
  theme_bw()

p4
ggsave('figures/fig4_top10_predictors.png', p4, width = 6, height = 4)
```
